about: Recording R0.8 20261022-1227 'rack4' (411.6 s). Checked by eye by Claude from the video before either system was run (2.5 s overview; 2-16 fps around every shot). Times are seconds from the start of the recording, 'at' = cue strike, about +/-0.5 s. Not reviewed by the player. Racking 0-40 s. The camera is knocked at ~302-306 s and the view stays shifted. Shots marked DOUBTFUL go to the player.
